data.one_liner: Convert Flutter Listenable and ValueListenable objects into Dart Streams and ValueStreams.
data.what_it_does: Extends Flutter's Listenable and ValueListenable classes to easily convert them into Dart Streams or RxDart ValueStreams. It enables reactive programming patterns directly from standard change notifiers.
use_when: You want to combine ChangeNotifier or ValueNotifier with RxDart stream operators.
You need to bridge standard Flutter listeners into a stream-based architecture.
avoid_when: You already use a comprehensive state management framework like Riverpod or Bloc that handles reactivity internally.
You prefer direct widget rebuilding via AnimatedBuilder rather than stream subscriptions.
strengths: Seamless integration between Flutter's built-in Listenable types and RxDart.
Supports replay value options for ValueListenable streams.
weaknesses: Adds an explicit dependency on rxdart.

alternatives.name: bloc
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides a robust, stream-based state management architecture out of the box.

alternatives.name: riverpod
alternatives.why_pick_it: Offers modern, compile-safe reactive state management without relying on ChangeNotifier.
